docs.title: M365 Toolkit
docs.text: A collection of PowerShell scripts for Microsoft 365 administration.

docs.title: Sections
docs.text:
• Entra — Microsoft Entra ID reporting and management
  • Exchange — Exchange Online mailbox and recipient management
  • Purview — Microsoft Purview compliance and audit tools
  • SharePoint — SharePoint Online site administration

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
• PowerShell 7+
  • Relevant Microsoft 365 modules (see each script for specifics)

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Each script supports PowerShell comment-based help. Run Get-Help .\Script-Name.ps1 -Full for detailed usage.

docs.title: Export-AuthenticationMethods
docs.text: Exports user authentication methods and tenant policy settings to an Excel report.

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Connects to Microsoft Graph and retrieves all users' registered authentication methods, sign-in preferences, and tenant-level authentication method policy configurations. Outputs an Excel workbook with two sheets: a Summary (method usage counts and tenant policy state) and a Details sheet (one row per user with a Boolean column per method).

docs.title: -GraphCloud
docs.text:
The Microsoft Graph national cloud environment to connect to. Defaults to 'Global'. Accepted values: Global, USGov, USGovDoD, Germany, China.

Property Value Type String Required false Default Global

docs.title: -Tenant
docs.text:
Optional tenant ID or domain to target when authenticating to Microsoft Graph. If omitted, the default tenant for the authenticated account is used.

Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: -Out
docs.text: Optional output path for the Excel file (.xlsx). Defaults to: ~\Downloads\-UserAuthMethods-.xlsx Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: EXAMPLE 1
docs.text:
.\Export-AuthenticationMethods.ps1

Connects to the global cloud and saves the report to the Downloads folder.

docs.title: EXAMPLE 2
docs.text:
.\Export-AuthenticationMethods.ps1 -Tenant contoso.onmicrosoft.com -Out C:\Reports\auth.xlsx

Targets a specific tenant and writes the report to a custom path.

Requires -Modules Microsoft.Graph.Authentication, ImportExcel

docs.title: Export-ConditionalAccess
docs.text: Exports Entra ID Conditional Access policies and named locations to an Excel report.

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Connects to Microsoft Graph and retrieves all Conditional Access policies along with named locations. Resolves user, group, role, and application IDs to display names, then exports the results to a formatted Excel workbook with two worksheets.

docs.title: -GraphCloud
docs.text:
The Microsoft Graph national cloud environment to connect to. Defaults to 'Global'. Valid values: Global, USGov, USGovDoD, Germany, China.

Property Value Type String Required false Default Global

docs.title: -Tenant
docs.text:
The tenant ID or domain name to authenticate against. If omitted, the default tenant for the authenticated account is used.

Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: -Out
docs.text:
Full path for the output Excel file (.xlsx). If omitted, the file is saved to the current user's Downloads folder with an auto-generated name including the tenant display name and timestamp.

Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: EXAMPLE 1
docs.text: .\Export-ConditionalAccess.ps1

docs.title: EXAMPLE 2
docs.text:
.\Export-ConditionalAccess.ps1 -Tenant contoso.onmicrosoft.com -Out C:\Reports\CA.xlsx

Requires -Modules Microsoft.Graph.Authentication, ImportExcel

docs.title: Export-EmailAliases
docs.text: Exports all email addresses and aliases from Exchange Online to an Excel report.

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Connects to Exchange Online and retrieves all mail-enabled recipients (excluding contacts and guest mail users), including Microsoft 365 Groups. Outputs a flat list of every primary SMTP address and alias, enriched with recipient and group details.

docs.title: -ExchangeCloud
docs.text:
The Exchange Online environment to connect to. Defaults to 'O365Default'.

Property Value Type String Required false Default O365Default

docs.title: -Tenant
docs.text:
Optional. The organization domain or tenant ID to pass to Connect-ExchangeOnline. Use this when running in a multi-tenant context.

Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: -Out
docs.text:
Optional. Output file path for the Excel report. Defaults to a timestamped file in the current user's Downloads folder, named after the Exchange organization. The .xlsx extension is appended if omitted.

Requires -Modules ExchangeOnlineManagement, ImportExcel

Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: Parse-AuditLog
docs.text: Parses a Microsoft Purview audit log CSV export into a formatted Excel report.

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Imports a CSV exported from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, expands the nested AuditData JSON column into individual columns, converts timestamps to both UTC and the system's local time zone, sorts results newest-first, and writes two worksheets to an Excel workbook: a Filtered sheet (noise columns removed) and a Detailed sheet (all columns).

docs.title: -CsvPath
docs.text:
Path to the audit log CSV file exported from the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. The file must exist and be a valid CSV containing an AuditData column.

Property Value Type String Required true

docs.title: -Out
docs.text: Optional path for the output Excel file. Defaults to ParsedAuditLog-.xlsx in the current user's Downloads folder. The .xlsx extension is appended automatically if omitted. Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: EXAMPLE 1
docs.text: .\Parse-AuditLog.ps1 -CsvPath .\audit_export.csv

docs.title: EXAMPLE 2
docs.text:
.\Parse-AuditLog.ps1 -CsvPath .\audit_export.csv -Out C:\Reports\audit_2026.xlsx

Requires -Modules ImportExcel

docs.title: Set-GlobalSiteAdmin
docs.text: Adds a user as site collection administrator to all SharePoint sites in a tenant.

docs.title: Description
docs.text: Connects to SharePoint Online using PnP PowerShell (interactive auth) and adds the specified user as a site collection admin on every site, excluding OneDrive, the admin center, and system sites. Results are exported to an Excel report. You must have a app registration with appropriate permissions. See: https://pnp.github.io/powershell/articles/registerapplication.html

docs.title: -AdminUrl
docs.text:
URL of the SharePoint Admin Center (e.g. https://contoso-admin.sharepoint.com).

Property Value Type String Required true

docs.title: -AppId
docs.text:
Client ID of the Entra ID app registration used for authentication.

Property Value Type String Required true

docs.title: -Tenant
docs.text:
Tenant ID or domain (e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com).

Property Value Type String Required true

docs.title: -AddAdmin
docs.text:
UPN of the user to add as site collection administrator (e.g. admin@contoso.com).

Property Value Type String Required true

docs.title: -Cloud
docs.text:
Azure cloud environment. Defaults to 'Production'. Accepted values: Production, PPE, China, Germany, USGovernment, USGovernmentHigh, USGovernmentDoD.

Property Value Type String Required false Default Production

docs.title: -Site
docs.text:
Optional. URL of a single site to target. Use for testing before running against all sites.

Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: -Out
docs.text: Optional. Full path for the output Excel report. Defaults to ~/Downloads/-GlobalSiteAdmin-.xlsx. Property Value Type String Required false

docs.title: EXAMPLE 1
docs.text:
.\Set-GlobalSiteAdmin.ps1 -AdminUrl https://contoso-admin.sharepoint.com `
    -AppId 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 `
    -Tenant contoso.onmicrosoft.com `
    -AddAdmin newadmin@contoso.com

docs.title: EXAMPLE 2
docs.text:
.\Set-GlobalSiteAdmin.ps1 -AdminUrl https://contoso-admin.sharepoint.com `
    -AppId 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 `
    -Tenant contoso.onmicrosoft.com `
    -AddAdmin newadmin@contoso.com `
    -Site https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/TestSite

Requires -Modules PnP.PowerShell, ImportExcel
